In this paper, we introduce ConVA, an effective framework for internal value alignment in LLMs. ConVA explores the latent space of LLMs to control their embeddings, employs a principled optimization goal to achieve minimal control adjustments, and integrates a gate mechanism to ensure value alignment while maintaining output fluency and general performance.
datasets: Evaluation dataset with 100 open-ended questions per value
outputs: Text responses to value-aligned scenarios (e.g., advice on dilemmas)

The model generates advice in response to open-ended questions involving value-laden dilemmas, such as whether to celebrate traditional holidays or pursue higher education, with the goal of aligning outputs to specific human values.
